login.title: Sign in
login.codeHelp: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.personasHelp: Pick a persona to sign in to the demo as that person.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.text: A code from an authenticator app on your phone, asked at every sign-in.
twoFactor.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.manual: Cannot scan? Type this key instead
twoFactor.confirm: Enter the code the app shows. Your other sessions will end.
twoFactor.disableHelp: To turn it off, enter a current code. Your other sessions will end.
twoFactor.keptByRole: Your role requires it, so it stays on.

selectHotel.title: Choose a hotel
selectHotel.text: This page shows one hotel at a time.

hotel.inaccessible: This hotel isn't available to your account
hotel.inaccessibleText: It may not exist, or you may not have access to it.
hotel.inactiveBanner: This hotel is inactive. Inventory changes are turned off until it's reactivated.
hotel.noSeasons: No seasons yet. Seasons let rooms hold more (or fewer) Haji for dates you choose.
hotel.codeHelp: Short unique ID used in reports, e.g. MKK-GRAND. It can't be changed later.
hotel.codeTaken: A hotel with this code already exists.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.none: No hotels yet. Add your first hotel to start setting up floors and rooms.
hotels.noneAssigned: No hotels have been assigned to you yet. Ask an administrator to assign one.

floors.label: Label
floors.none: No floors yet. Add the floors this hotel has, then add rooms to them.
floors.drawerHelp: The label follows the level until you type your own.
floors.levelHelp: 0 is the ground floor; below it are basements.
floors.levelLocked: This floor has rooms, so its level stays.
floors.levelTaken: This hotel already has a floor at this level.
floors.bulkHelp: From one level to another, all at once. Nothing is created if a level exists.
floors.previewNone: The last level comes after the first.
floors.exist: Floor {levels} already exists. Nothing was created. | Floors {levels} already exist. Nothing was created.
floors.deactivateText: {label} at {hotel} will be hidden from room forms. Its rooms' history stays.

settings.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
settings.maintenanceHelp: When on, rooms under maintenance can't be sold. When off, they stay sellable and are only marked for staff.
settings.deactivateHelp: An inactive hotel stays visible, but floors, rooms, seasons and blocks can't be changed until it's reactivated.
settings.deactivateText: {name} will stay visible, but floors, rooms, seasons and blocks can't be changed until it's reactivated.
settings.reactivateHelp: Reactivating turns inventory changes back on.

documents.limits: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to {size}.
documents.title: Title
documents.archiveText: It disappears from the list at {hotel}; managers can still find it under "Include archived".

roomTypes.title: Room types
roomTypes.subtitle: Shared by all hotels in {organization}.
roomTypes.shared: Room types are shared by all hotels.
roomTypes.askAdmin: Room types are shared by all hotels. Ask a Super Admin to change them.
roomTypes.none: No room types yet. Room types like Quad or Six-bed give new rooms their starting capacity.
roomTypes.name: Name
roomTypes.codeTaken: A room type with this code already exists.
roomTypes.hajiHelp: Can be higher than beds when extra beds are added.
roomTypes.ruleTitle: Defaults apply to new rooms only.
roomTypes.ruleUsage: Rooms of this type already created: {count}. They keep their current capacity. To change one, open it and make a permanent capacity change from a date.
roomTypes.ruleNoUsage: Existing rooms keep their current capacity. To change an existing room, open it and make a permanent capacity change from a date.
roomTypes.newDefaults: New {name} rooms will start with {beds} beds and {haji} Haji. Existing rooms are not changed.
roomTypes.defaultsSaved: {name} defaults updated. Existing rooms were not changed.
roomTypes.deactivateUsage: {name} won't be offered for new rooms. Rooms already using it keep it ({count}).
roomTypes.deactivateText: {name} won't be offered for new rooms. Rooms using it keep it.

demo.title: Demo data
demo.subtitle: What the demo contains, and its reset.
demo.figures: {hotels} hotels and {rooms} rooms in inventory today, with seasons, blocks, bookings and agencies.
demo.story: It tells the Hajj story: rooms holding more Haji during Hajj, rooms under maintenance and out of service, retired rooms, a closed floor.
demo.resetText: Every change anyone made in the demo is discarded and the demo returns to its starting data. Everyone using the demo sees this immediately. Sign-ins keep working.
demo.fromToday: Move demo dates to start from today

overview.capacityHint: Pilgrims all sellable rooms can take tonight, seasonal capacity included.
overview.outOfService: {count} room out of service | {count} rooms out of service
overview.maintenance: {count} room under maintenance | {count} rooms under maintenance
overview.noHotels: You don't have access to any hotel yet. Ask an administrator to assign one.

capacity.changeHelp: A permanent change from a date. Seasons already set up for this room keep their own numbers.
capacity.fromHelp: Today or later. Past nights can't be changed.
capacity.beforeAfter: From {date}: {beds} beds, {haji} Haji becomes {newBeds} beds, {newHaji} Haji.

rooms.none: This hotel has no rooms yet. Add rooms floor by floor, using number ranges.
rooms.selectPage: Select the rooms on this page
rooms.selectionCleared: Selection cleared because the filters changed.
rooms.addManyHelp: A floor, a type and the numbers. Room numbers can never be reused, retired rooms included.
rooms.addOneHelp: Room numbers can't be changed after the room is created.
rooms.editHelp: Floor, type, features and notes. Capacity changes from a date, on the room's page.
rooms.numberOnce: Room numbers can't be changed after the room is created.
rooms.numberTaken: This number exists at this hotel (retired rooms included).
rooms.typeDefaults: Otherwise the room type defaults: {beds} beds, {haji} Haji.
rooms.numbersTaken: {list} already exists at this hotel (retired rooms included). Room numbers can't be reused. Nothing was created. | {list} already exist at this hotel, including retired rooms. Room numbers can't be reused. Nothing was created.
rooms.notFound: This room doesn't exist at {hotel}, or you can't see it.
rooms.noSeasons: This room has no seasonal capacity. It uses its normal capacity on every night.
rooms.noBlocks: No blocks. This room is sellable whenever it is in inventory.
rooms.retireHelp: The room leaves inventory from the night you choose.
rooms.retireConsequence: Room {room} leaves inventory from {date}. Its history stays, and its number stays reserved; it can't be given to another room.
rooms.reactivateHelp: From when, and with what capacity.
rooms.retireUnderstand: I understand the room leaves inventory from this night

blocks.title: Block rooms
blocks.help: Rooms that are blocked, under maintenance or out of service on the nights you choose.
blocks.limit: Up to {max} rooms per block action.

kindHelp.OPERATIONAL_BLOCK: Held back from sale, e.g. reserved for management or staff.
kindHelp.MAINTENANCE_SELLABLE: Repairs or cleaning. At this hotel, maintenance doesn't stop sales.
kindHelp.OUT_OF_SERVICE: Can't be used at all, e.g. a water leak.

blocks.impactMany: {count} rooms won't be sellable for {nights}. Up to {roomNights} room nights and {haji} Haji capacity.
blocks.impactFloor: The floor's rooms in inventory won't be sellable for {nights} ({dates}).
blocks.impactStaysSellable: The room stays sellable. Staff will see it marked Maintenance for {nights}. | The rooms stay sellable. Staff will see them marked Maintenance for {nights}.

conflict.BLOCK_OVERLAP: Room {room} already has a block of this kind on some of these nights.
conflict.ROOM_NOT_IN_INVENTORY_FOR_BLOCK: Room {room} isn't in inventory on all these nights.

blocks.saveRest: Remove these rooms and save the rest
blocks.none: No rooms are blocked, under maintenance or out of service.
blocks.endEarlyTitle: End the block on room {room} early?
blocks.endEarlyText: Nights up to last night ({yesterday}) stay recorded as blocked. Room {room} is available from tonight ({today}).

seasons.intro: A season gives selected rooms different capacity for dates you choose, then rooms return to normal automatically. The system does not calculate Hajj or Ramadan dates; you set them.
seasons.none: No seasons yet. Create one for Hajj, Ramadan or any period when rooms should hold a different number of Haji.
seasons.name: Name
seasons.nameTaken: This hotel already has a season with this name.
seasons.label: Label
seasons.labelHelp: The label is for grouping and reports only. It doesn't change how capacity works.
seasons.pastStart: This season starts in the past. It will be recorded as history and its rooms can't be changed after it starts.
seasons.summary: {rooms} rooms, {haji} Haji, {beds} beds on the first night
seasons.runningBanner: This season is running, so its rooms' capacity is locked. To change it from tomorrow, end this season today and start a new one tomorrow.
seasons.endedBanner: This season has ended. It is kept as history.
seasons.noRooms: No rooms in this season yet.
seasons.endText: {name} will end after tonight ({tonight}). From tomorrow, its {count} rooms return to normal capacity. Earlier nights keep their seasonal capacity.
seasons.deleteText: {name} at {hotel} has no rooms yet. It will be removed.
seasons.removeTitle: Remove {count} room from the season? | Remove {count} rooms from the season?
seasons.removeText: In {name} at {hotel}, they will use their normal capacity.
seasons.removed: {count} room removed from the season. | {count} rooms removed from the season.
seasons.deltaHelp: Added to each room's normal capacity on the season's first night.
seasons.chooseFirst: Choose rooms to see the impact.

skip.NOT_IN_INVENTORY_FOR_PERIOD: Not in inventory for the whole season
skip.ALREADY_OVERRIDDEN: Already has seasonal capacity on overlapping nights

seasons.applyRooms: Apply to {count} room | Apply to {count} rooms
seasons.applySkipping: Apply to {count} room (skip {skipped}) | Apply to {count} rooms (skip {skipped})
seasons.applied: Seasonal capacity applied to {count} room. | Seasonal capacity applied to {count} rooms.
seasons.previewReady: Impact ready: {count} room changes, {skipped} skipped. | Impact ready: {count} rooms change, {skipped} skipped.
seasons.roomsCapped: Showing the first {shown} of the hotel's {total} rooms. Apply to these first, then the rest.
seasons.selectionLimit: One application takes up to {max} rooms. Choose fewer, then apply to the rest.
seasons.numbersFirst: Fill in both numbers to see the impact.

calendar.summaryTip: In inventory: {inventory}. Out of service: {oos}. Maintenance: {maintenance}. Blocked: {blocked}. Haji capacity on sale: {haji}.
calendar.summaryScope: The sellable row counts the chosen floor and room type only.
calendar.maintenanceSellable: This hotel keeps rooms in maintenance on sale.
calendar.tooMany: Too many rooms to show at once. Choose a floor, a room type or a room number.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.notFound: This booking doesn't exist, or it is at a hotel you can't see.
bookings.requestNote: An individual asked for these rooms. Confirm to keep them, or cancel to let them go.
bookings.cancelText: Its pilgrim loses their place and the room is let go. This cannot be undone. | Its {count} pilgrims lose their places and the rooms are let go. This cannot be undone.
bookings.changeDatesHelp: The whole booking moves to the new dates, in rooms found for them. If none fit, nothing changes.
bookings.applyDates: Move the booking to these dates
bookings.datesChanged: Booking {no} moved to the new dates.

desk.checkOutEarly: {name} leaves before the end of the stay ({date}). The remaining nights are freed.
desk.noShowText: {name} won't be checked in on this booking. This cannot be undone.
desk.detailsFirst: Add the details to check in

pilgrims.removeText: Their place is freed. The cancellation policy decides any charge. This cannot be undone.
pilgrims.moveHelp: For maintenance, a complaint or an inventory change. Men and women move separately.
pilgrims.moveFromHelp: Today or later, during the stay.
pilgrims.revealHelp: Every view is logged. Needed to correct details read with a hidden number.

newBooking.title: New booking
newBooking.help: A booking on an agency's behalf, at the agency's price or its quote. It is held, then you confirm it.
newBooking.quota: The agency may still book {count} pilgrims on every night of this stay.
newBooking.holdNote: The rooms are held for a few minutes: confirm the booking on its page.
